# Tradebd – Trading Academy & Technical Analysis Platform

> Tradebd is a free Forex and Cryptocurrency financial education academy, interactive candlestick technical analysis platform, Bangladesh Standard Time (BST UTC+6) economic calendar, and customizable virtual paper trading simulator.

Tradebd provides free, institutional-grade market education and real-time technical charting tools in English, Bengali, and 17 global languages. Learners can practice analyzing BTC/USDT, ETH/USDT, EUR/USD, GBP/USD, USD/JPY, and XAU/USD (Gold) using Exponential Moving Averages (EMA 20/50/200), Bollinger Bands, RSI (14), Volume, and Support/Resistance levels without financial risk.

## Core Platform Tools

- [Live Candlestick Chart & Technical Analysis Platform](https://tradebd.online/): Interactive multi-timeframe candlestick charts with EMA, Bollinger Bands, RSI, Volume, and quick order execution.
- [Virtual Paper Trading Simulator](https://tradebd.online/simulator): Risk-free Long and Short virtual trading simulator with customizable demo balance ($10 to $10,000,000), leverage, Stop-Loss, and Take-Profit automation.
- [Forex Economic Calendar & Global Market Sessions (BST)](https://tradebd.online/calendar): Live Sydney, Tokyo, London, and New York market session clocks in Bangladesh Standard Time (UTC+6) and high-impact economic news tracker.
- [Forex & Crypto Trading Academy Course](https://tradebd.online/academy): Structured beginner-to-institutional trading lessons covering market structure, price action, indicators, and risk management.
- [Candlestick Chart Patterns Guide](https://tradebd.online/patterns): Visual reference library and cheat sheet for bullish and bearish candlestick patterns with entry and exit rules.
- [Position Size & Risk Calculator](https://tradebd.online/calculator): Professional lot size, pip value, and Risk-to-Reward (R:R) ratio calculator for enforcing the 1%–2% capital protection rule.
- [Interactive Chart Setup Mentor](https://tradebd.online/mentor): Practice evaluating trade setups, RSI momentum, and EMA alignment.

## Educational Trading Blog & Guides

- [Educational Trading Blog Hub](https://tradebd.online/blog): Bilingual articles on Forex trading, candlestick patterns, trading psychology, and risk management.
- [Complete Forex Trading Guide](https://tradebd.online/blog/forex-trading-bangla-complete-guide): Beginner-to-pro guide to currency pairs, pips, lots, leverage, and market structure.
- [Candlestick Chart Patterns Masterclass](https://tradebd.online/blog/candlestick-chart-patterns-bangla-guide): How to identify Hammer, Engulfing, Doji, Morning Star, and Shooting Star setups.
- [Risk Management & Lot Size Formula](https://tradebd.online/blog/risk-management-lot-size-stop-loss-formula): How to calculate Stop-Loss and protect trading capital using the 1% rule.
- [Best Forex Trading Sessions in Bangladesh Time (BST)](https://tradebd.online/blog/best-forex-trading-sessions-bangladesh-time-bst): Detailed schedule of Sydney, Tokyo, London, and New York sessions in UTC+6.
